phases.text: Players establish the stakes and decide whether the hallway becomes a public scene.
Stress rises when accusations lack leverage or force is used badly.
Known clues and social feats convert evidence into resolve.
Failure advances the scene into a messier but still playable state.
The confrontation resolves quietly, publicly, or messily.

outcomes.text: The guard steps aside because the evidence gives everyone a face-saving exit.
The door opens, but the hallway remembers the threat and broken furniture.
The public accusation misses, but witnesses now know which question matters.
The shove fails, but the bruise proves the latch is real and moves the case forward.
